description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Soldevi Excavations from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Soldevi Excavations into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Soldevi Excavations from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Soldevi Excavations from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Soldevi Excavations into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
